exclusion_detail: All final compounds (15-19, 23) are platinum(II) complexes of cyclobutane-dicarboxylate ligands (carboplatin analogues); metal complexes are out of scope. The abstract names no single best compound (iodocarboplatin 17 most active on SK-OV-3, ketocarboplatin 16 on HCT116/D3E2).

lead.label: none single (15-19, 23 are Pt complexes)
lead.why: Abstract: 'the tested compounds were up to six times more potent than carboplatin'; no one compound is named best.

notes: Organic ligand precursors (e.g. 3-substituted cyclobutane-1,1-dicarboxylates 9-11, 22) are intermediates only; every endpoint is a Pt complex.
